summary: Square's time-and-dimension JRPG series, covering Chrono Trigger, the Satellaview text-adventure side story Radical Dreamers, and Chrono Cross with its modern Radical Dreamers Edition.

entries.title: Chrono Trigger

emulation.emulator: melonDS or DeSmuME; bsnes for SNES comparison
emulation.notes: Use a readable two-screen layout for DS capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Clean DS output with full DS content; SNES via bsnes for original comparison.

primary.version: Nintendo DS release via melonDS or original DS hardware
primary.why: The DS version includes the PS1 animated cutscenes, updated translation, extra gameplay content, bug fixes, fast load behavior, DS-mode UI, and mini-map; current comparison coverage still ranks it above Steam despite Steam being easier to buy.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped DS cartridge image in melonDS with a clean two-screen layout, or play on original DS/DSi hardware. Use Steam only if buying a current digital copy matters more than the DS-exclusive features.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Steam/mobile route is convenient but not a full replacement for the DS version's interface and exclusive content.

entries.title: Radical Dreamers
entries.definitive_edition: Chrono Cross: The Radical Dreamers Edition

emulation.emulator: Satellaview/BS-X preservation setup only for historical comparison
emulation.notes: Use native PC release for the main route.

primary.version: Chrono Cross: The Radical Dreamers Edition
primary.why: Radical Dreamers was originally a Japan-only Satellaview text adventure, but the 2022 Radical Dreamers Edition includes it officially alongside Chrono Cross on modern platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Play Chrono Cross: The Radical Dreamers Edition on Steam/Windows and select Radical Dreamers. Use the original Satellaview route only for preservation comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The original Satellaview release is preserved historically but no longer the practical route.

entries.title: Chrono Cross
entries.definitive_edition: Chrono Cross: The Radical Dreamers Edition

emulation.notes: Use native PC remaster for the main run.

primary.version: Chrono Cross: The Radical Dreamers Edition
primary.why: The 2022 Radical Dreamers Edition is the modern remaster of Chrono Cross, with HD-upgraded models, new illustrations, new features, and Radical Dreamers included; PC gives the best capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Chrono Cross: The Radical Dreamers Edition on Steam/Windows. Use the original PlayStation release through DuckStation only for original-performance comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remaster changes presentation; use DuckStation only to compare original PS1 look/performance.
